payload.title: Reject naive structural extrapolation
payload.decision: Retain last-known TVT and reject unconditional constant, heel-linear, quadratic, and damped-spline continuation of U=TVT+Z. Keep U only as an interpretable representation, diagnostic coordinate, and candidate-feature space.
payload.rationale: All controls passed, but the best challenger scored 39.6546 versus 15.9099 and improved 0/25 frozen fold cells. Oracle diagnostics show that a median U-slope error of only 0.00819 ft per row compounds across long suffixes even though visible and hidden U slopes correlate 0.928.
payload.revisit_trigger: A legal feature set predicts heel-to-toe U-slope change or hidden TVT drift with signed repeated-fold evidence and all controls.
